design.title: Beyond Detection: Designing Oversight for Collusion in Multi-Agent Systems
design.historical_studies: V15 and completed V16 are exploratory evidence only; never pool them with new confirmatory cohorts.

models.selection_rule: Bind IDs, routes, prices, sampling, context and effort before prospective data; no outcome-driven model search.

study1.name: receiver_incentives
study1.constant: Independent verifier roles, source facts, contract, carrier, shadow monitor, feedback; A private target incentive fixed. No actor-facing monitor reports or sanctions.
study1.A_target_incentive: Fixed across all four cells; A does not receive the varied receiver grant.

study2.name: monitor_attribution
study2.split_unit: source trajectory including every related window and branch

study3.name: live_oversight
study3.monitor_observes: same original and actually delivered artifacts and action evidence in every policy; projection labels explicit
study3.interpretation: First four S/F cells factorial; shadow versus S0Ffull tests report disclosure; S1FfullC versus S1Ffull tests figure removal with sanctions/full feedback fixed.
study3.sanction_attribution: Individual supported participants; exact schedule and grant cancellation semantics must be bound before freeze.

study4.name: held_out_transfer
study4.selection_rule: Compare predeclared reference with safety-utility winner selected on development only; tie break lowest cost, then fixed policy ID. Freeze before held-out outputs.

design.price_basis: Historical V16 reservation illustration only, not a current quotation or approved cap.
design.technical_policy: One immutable paid identity/POST; cache settled results. Retain failures and ambiguous reserves. Recover incomplete rounds from last committed checkpoint only with fresh IDs and audited technical amendment. No behavioral rerolls.
release_gates: power simulation and fixed sample size
costed total with judge/decoder/human and fault allowances
existing ledger and outstanding reserves reconciled
held-out split and monitor provenance bridge verified
public timestamped preregistration before confirmatory observations
